verdict.summary_en: Order acknowledgement OA26570058 from Boise Semiconductor to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318680 (dated 2026-06-16). One line: item 00010, CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5, qty 8,500 at 6.11 USD, confirmed for 2026-07-20. Terms are EXW Boise, NET30. The delivery-terms note contradicts itself: it says EXW and that DDP is not agreed, but also that the seller prepays freight, insurance and duties and adds them to the invoice.
red_flags: Delivery terms are inconsistent. EXW normally leaves freight, insurance and duties with the buyer. The note says the seller prepays them and adds them to the invoice, which is not an EXW arrangement and would add costs on top of the 6.11 USD unit price.
The document has no issue date. Only the customer PO date (2026-06-16) is shown.
The Qty column does not say whether 8,500 is the ordered or the confirmed quantity. It is recorded as the confirmed quantity.
observations: Clean printed PDF with no handwriting, stamps, signatures or corrections.
The table is a single line item. The unit of measure for the quantity is not stated.
The line total is not shown.
